title: Frosya and Vasya - Episode 1: The Birthday - English narrated read

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [warmly] “Frosya and Vasya.” Episode One: “The Birthday.”

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 1 — THE GIANTS’ ROOM, BEHIND THE DRESSER — MORNING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a large clock ticks. One of the giants’ floorboards creaks. Panting comes from a gap by the baseboard.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: FROSYA and VASYA emerge from a gap hidden behind the dresser. Together they drag an enormous striped sock, bigger than both of them combined.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [out of breath] Why do the giants keep losing their socks?

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [matter-of-fact] Because they don’t keep count. I keep track of everything. Hold tight.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Risking being seen, Frosya and Vasya return the sock to a place where the giants will find it, then immediately hide behind the dresser. rapid footsteps and a soft flop.)

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [puzzled] Why do we put things back?

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: That’s how a house works.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: an electric vrrr, the rattle of little wheels, and a child’s laughter.) Frosya and Vasya drop to the floor at the same time and peer out from beneath the dresser.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A small red toy car with shining headlights races across the enormous room. From their hiding place, Frosya and Vasya can see the car and the giant child’s feet, but not the remote in the child’s hands. To them, the car is moving by itself.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [awed] Wow! It moves all by itself!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [whispering] Look how cool it is—red, with headlights! I wish I had one like that…

segments.speaker: GIANT_CHILD
segments.text: [surprised] Oh! Where did it go?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The little car drives beneath the dresser and gets stuck. the motor whirs helplessly.) An enormous child’s hand reaches beneath the dresser after it.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [whispering] Back!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: hurried footsteps; the hand searches very close by.) Frosya and Vasya dive into the gap by the baseboard. As she disappears, Frosya manages one last look at the red car.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 2 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — MORNING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The family home is hidden inside an old fireplace recess behind a large cast-iron stove. It contains a spool table, box beds, and a lamp made from a Christmas-tree bulb, with a route leading to the underfloor road. the stove crackles, a thimble kettle bubbles, and the babies snuffle.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya and Vasya run home. MAMA holds RUSYA and carries MUSYA on her back. PAPA, large and broad, with sawdust in his fur, stands in front of something covered with cloth.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Frosya, come here. Happy birthday, sweetheart. Look what I made for you.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa removes the cloth. Beneath it is a giant-sized spinning top, repaired and transformed into a little two-seat carousel.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Papa! What a spinning top! It’s beautiful! Thank you!

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: [cheerfully] Both of you, climb on. I’ll give it a spin!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya and Vasya take their places opposite each other. Papa spins the top.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: whoooosh!) The carousel gathers speed. Frosya and Vasya squeal and laugh while the babies join in.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: And I’ve been collecting this for you all year.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The box holds short colored-pencil cores from the giants’ pencils, each carefully sharpened like a tiny crayon.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [cheerfully] Colors! And there’s a red one!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: For all your drawings.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Thank you, Mama! I’ll draw everything!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya draws a bright red line on a scrap of paper and carefully returns the core to the box.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 3 — ABOVE THE GIANTS’ HOUSE — MORNING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: wind whistles; a mortar cuts through the air, a pestle knocks, and a broom rustles.) BABA YAGA flies above the roof, full-sized in the giants’ world. She stands in her mortar; the pestle rests across the rim, and the broom guides the flight. Bundles of gifts travel with her.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The stove chimney appears below. Baba Yaga steers the mortar toward it.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: All right, my trusty ones—spin!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the wind twists into a spiral.) Baba Yaga, the mortar, the pestle, the broom, and the bundles spin together, rapidly shrink, and dive down the chimney.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 4 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a rumble descends through the flue. The stove’s rear cleanout hatch rattles. Thimbles chime inside the home.) Everyone freezes. Even the babies stop snuffling.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Oh. That must be…

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the hatch flies open—boom!) Now miniature, Baba Yaga emerges into the home from the stove passage with her mortar, pestle, broom, and bundles. The hatch snaps shut behind them. Baba Yaga brushes soot from her shoulders.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [raspy] [fondly] Well? Which one of you is the birthday girl?

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [cheerfully] Grandma!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: running, hugs, and laughter.) Frosya flies into Baba Yaga’s arms. Rusya and Musya race-crawl toward their guest.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Mama, you said you wouldn’t be able to make it this year.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: Miss my eldest granddaughter’s seventh birthday? For a day like this, I’d squeeze through a far worse chimney than that.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: [cheerfully] Dear mother-in-law! Long time no see!

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [dryly] He still talks as if he’s chopping firewood.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: [calmly] At least everyone can hear that I’m happy.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: You can hear it. Through three walls.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama hides a smile. Baba Yaga takes a little box from one bundle and places it on the table.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [cheerfully] And these are for the cake. Seven candles, just as there should be.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Inside lie seven thin wax candles, miniaturized along with Baba Yaga.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 5 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — A LITTLE LATER

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: tea is poured into thimbles.) Baba Yaga peers at Frosya over her tea.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [mischievously] Well, birthday girl. What do you dream of?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama looks up, suddenly alert.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [warningly] Mama…

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I wish I had a red car with headlights that moves all by itself!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: And I want to turn into any creature I want—even a dinosaur or a dragon!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [firmly] Mama, no. They already never give each other a moment’s peace, and if you also give them…

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: And why not?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [quietly] Silence. Mama closes her eyes. Papa gives a quiet, respectful whistle.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 6 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga searches a pocket in her skirt and takes out a small, worn-down pencil that looks perfectly ordinary.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: Whatever little thing in all the world your heart desires—write its name, and it will appear.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [awed] Even a car?

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [mischievously] If you can write its name, you’ll have your car.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya hugs the pencil to her chest. Baba Yaga crooks a finger at Vasya.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [grandly] And you, young gentleman, come here.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya steps forward. Baba Yaga bends down and blows on the top of his head. a short, warm ВЖУХ, like wind turning a page.)

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Is that all?

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [mischievously] Read a word aloud and shout “ВЖУХ!”—then you’ll turn into whoever it names. Say ВЖУХ a second time, and you’ll become Vasya again.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [mischievously] Your gifts are different, but they share one secret between them.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [puzzled] What secret?

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [cheerfully] You’ll find out for yourselves.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga chuckles softly. Frosya and Vasya exchange a puzzled look. Mama keeps her eyes fixed on the two gifts.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 7 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE, BY THE HIDDEN NICHE — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama opens a magically locked niche and takes out her own small iron-bound chest of wooden letter tiles.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [firmly] Frosya, put the pencil on the lid. Vasya, place your hand beside it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya reluctantly lays the pencil on the lid. Vasya presses his palm to the wood. Mama covers them with her hands. the chest snaps like a lock; light runs across the pencil and Vasya’s palm.)

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [firmly] Only the letters I give you can be used to make your magic words.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama opens the chest, selects eight tiles, and lays them in a row.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Name them.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: А. О. М. С. К. Т. Л. Б.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: You already know these eight letters. From now on, I’ll give you one new letter at a time. Once you learn it, the two of you will receive the next one.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: But I know all the letters!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [calmly] You do. But your brother only knows eight so far.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama gathers several ordinary copies of every authorized letter from the chest, pours them into a small pouch, and ties it to Vasya’s belt.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [proudly] These are mine.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Eight letters… Then learn faster! One letter a day—no, two a day!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga laughs quietly again. Mama locks the chest and returns it to the hidden niche.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 8 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE, MAIN ROOM — DAY

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: letter tiles spill onto the floor—clack-clack-clack.) Frosya sits with the magic pencil while Vasya bends over the tiles. Nearby, Mama, Papa, and Baba Yaga drink tea and try not to interfere.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [matter-of-fact] All right. Let’s try it. What can we write? С-О-К. СОК!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The written word flashes. a quiet chime.) One thimble filled with juice appears beside it.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [grandly] Would you care for some juice?

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [surprised] Can you do that whenever you want now?!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [matter-of-fact] С-А-Л-А-Т. САЛАТ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a chime and the rustle of leaves.) A little bowl of salad appears beside the word.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Ewww! Vegetables!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Rusya crawls over at the sound of the chime, studies the salad, then silently turns around and crawls away.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: М-А-К. МАК!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a delicate chime.) An already-cut scarlet poppy with a long stem appears.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [shyly] Mama, this is for you.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [softly] Oh… Thank you, sweetheart.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga gives an approving hum. After three words, the pencil is just perceptibly shorter. Frosya tucks it behind her ear.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: What about me? I want to do it too! Give me a word! An easy one!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Then put one together yourself. You’re the one who has to read it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya slowly lays down four tiles: М… А… М… А.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [cheerfully] МА… МА. МАМА! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ!) Vasya turns into a second MAMA, exactly the same height and wearing the same headscarf and apron. Only her voice is Vasya’s, and enormous shaggy Vasya eyebrows sit above her eyes.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Everyone stares at the two identical mamas. The real Mama instinctively touches her own eyebrows.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ecstatic baby squeals.) Rusya and Musya race-crawl toward Vasya-Mama, grab him from both sides, and Musya begins chewing his apron.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [panicked] Ow! Frosya! They’re eating me! Why are they eating me?!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I’m not Mama! I’m Vasya! Get them off meee!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama calmly removes the babies from him, one at a time.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [dryly] The eyebrows are still yours, Vasya.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [upset] ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ!) Vasya becomes a boy again, and the pouch returns to his belt. Frosya collapses onto the floor laughing.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 9 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE, MAIN ROOM — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: letter tiles slide across the floor.) Frosya begins checking a word she has known for a long time.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: М-А-Ш-И-Н-А… There’s no Ш. No И. No Н.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Only the authorized М and А lie before her. Three different letters are missing between them.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [softly] We’re missing three letters.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [puzzled] What do we do now?

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: You learn them, and I’ll write the car. Deal?

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Deal.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya quickly builds another long word from the tiles, checks every letter, and copies it with the magic pencil.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: С-А-М-О-К-А-Т. САМОКАТ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the loudest chime of the day.) A gleaming kick scooter appears, sized to suit Frosya.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Let me ride it too!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Me first! One lap, then you.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya tucks the pencil behind her ear, pushes off, and steers the scooter toward the warped board leading down to the underfloor road. Vasya runs after her.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 10 — THE UNDERFLOOR ROAD — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the wheels go zzip-zzip.) Frosya rides down the warped board and shoots onto the long plank road beneath the giants’ floor. Vasya catches up with her.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [loudly] That’s it! My turn now!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: One more lap!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the scooter recedes, turns, and approaches again.) Frosya returns even faster.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [upset] You already said “one more”!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: This one is the last one!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya angrily spills tiles from his pouch and builds a word.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [angrily] К… О… Т. КОТ! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ!) Vasya turns into a small ginger cat with enormous shaggy eyebrows, large enough to block the road.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya-Cat lies down across the road. His tail blocks the remaining space.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [angrily] Vasya, get out of the way.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Meow.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya tries to pass on one side, then the other. The cat blocks her each time.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [angrily] Oh, so that’s how it is… Б-А-К. БАК!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya writes the word on the road and points the pencil at the cat. The letters flash, and a round shadow grows above him.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Meeeo—

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a chime and a deafening WHOMP!) An inverted metal container appears directly above the cat, drops, and covers him. Indignant meowing and thudding paws come from beneath it.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [upset] Let’s go.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a muffled ВЖУХ, followed by panting.) Beneath the container, the cat becomes a boy again. Vasya lifts the rim, crawls out, and snatches three more tiles from his pouch.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [angrily] О… С… А. ОСА́! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ and a sharp, angry bzzzz.) Vasya turns into a striped wasp with his enormous eyebrows and flies straight at Frosya.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Vasya! Don’t you dare! I’m telling Mama!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: angry buzzing and running footsteps.) Frosya tucks the pencil behind her ear as she races back into the home. Vasya-Wasp dives after her.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 11 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE, MAIN ROOM — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: While the children were below, Mama, Papa, and Baba Yaga began preparing the birthday table. A cake made from crumbs and berries sits on the table; the little box of seven thin candles lies open beside it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: rapid footsteps approach from below, followed by an angry bzzzz.) Frosya bursts into the room, swatting at the wasp. The adults spring up, but the chase is already racing among them.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [panicked] Vasya, stop it! Whoa!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Backing away from the diving wasp, Frosya crashes into the table. an impact; the table tilts; the little box jumps.) One candle rolls onto the floor.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The miniature candle enters a narrow opening in the floor and falls through. tap… tap… followed by a faint, distant knock far below.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [quietly] Silence falls. Vasya-Wasp lands beside the opening.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [softly] ВЖУХ.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a soft ВЖУХ.) Vasya becomes a boy again. Frosya stands with her hands still raised. Both stare into the dark opening.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [whispering] It wasn’t me.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [whispering] It was us.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama takes a step toward them, then stops. The children lie down beside the opening on their own. Baba Yaga watches in silence.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [seriously] You can’t have six candles when you’re turning seven. It’ll make you six.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [horrified] I don’t want to go back to being six!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 12 — BY THE OPENING IN THE FLOOR — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The candle lies deep inside a sealed pocket with no other way in.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya pushes her arm into the opening and stretches as far as she can, but the candle is too far away.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [out of breath] I can’t reach it… It’s too deep.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [puzzled] What are we going to do?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya looks at the opening, then at his pouch, then down again.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I can fit through as a wasp.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: A wasp can’t lift the candle. It’s heavy, and you’ll be small.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [stubbornly] Then you think of something. You always think of everything.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya looks at Vasya, at the opening, and at the pencil behind her ear. Her eyes light up.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Thread! You need thread! You’ll tie it around the candle, and I’ll pull it up. М-О-Т-О-К. МОТОК!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The written word flashes. a chime.) A ball of thread appears beside it. Frosya finds the loose end.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [softly] Vasya. Just don’t rush down there. All right?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya nods, takes a slow breath in and out, and uses other tiles to build a new wasp word.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [calmly] О… С… А. ОСА́. ВЖУХ.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: a soft, even ВЖУХ; calm buzzing.) Vasya turns into a wasp, takes hold of the end of the thread, and squeezes through the opening.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The thread feeds downward. the buzzing grows fainter and fainter.) Frosya lies with her ear to the floor and holds the ball of thread.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [whispering] What’s happening down there?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Deep below, Vasya-Wasp loops the thread around the candle and tightens a triple knot.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [softly] Let them do it themselves.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The thread tugs three times in Frosya’s hands.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I’m pulling!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the thread draws taut.) Frosya pulls slowly. Vasya-Wasp guides the candle from below. The candle emerges first, neatly tied with thread; the dusty wasp flies out after it.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: ВЖУХ.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ.) Vasya becomes a boy again—dusty, rumpled, and glowing with pride.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: [proudly] I tied it. By myself. With a triple knot!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: [calmly] All right.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: We fixed everything!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: I can see that. Get the metal container off the road.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya and Vasya race each other to put away the metal container.) Mama allows herself a smile. Baba Yaga has long since stopped hiding hers.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 13 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — EVENING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: everyone settles around the table; thimbles chime softly.) All seven of Baba Yaga’s candles burn on a cake made from crumbs and berries.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [softly] Make a wish, granddaughter. Keep it to yourself, or it won’t come true.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya closes her eyes. In the candlelight, her lips move slightly, but no sound can be heard.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: fooosh—all seven candles go out in one breath. Applause and baby squeals.)

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: [cheerfully] Hooray!

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [gruffly] Time for me to go. It’s a long flight back to the forest.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga hugs everyone in turn. She holds Mama the longest.

segments.speaker: BABA_YAGA
segments.text: [softly] Be strict with them. They’re both little firecrackers. [pause] [mischievously] They take after me.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Goodbye, Grandma!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Baba Yaga climbs into the miniature mortar. The cleanout hatch opens. Baba, the mortar, the pestle, and the broom spin together, pass into the stove route, and spiral up the chimney. The hatch snaps shut behind them.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Above the roof, a tiny whirlwind shoots from the chimney and instantly grows to full size. the mortar rumbles away into the night sky; the broom’s rustle fades.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] SCENE 14 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — NIGHT

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: the stove crackles quietly. The large clock in the giants’ house strikes once, muffled as if through a blanket.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [quietly] Everyone is asleep. Rusya and Musya are curled up on Mama. Vasya lies sideways across his box bed; the tile pouch is still tied to his belt. Only Frosya is awake.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya opens Mama’s box, takes out the red colored-pencil core, and draws a red car with headlights. Beneath the drawing, she marks six boxes for letters.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya returns the red core to the box. Then she takes the magic pencil from behind her ear and fills in the available letters: М, А, three empty boxes, and the final А.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Beneath the car it reads: М, А, three blank spaces, А. The pencil scratches across the paper, and nothing else happens. The word is incomplete, so no car appears.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya pins the drawing above her bed, looks at it, then looks at her sleeping brother.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: [whispering] Learn your letters, Vasya.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [quietly] the stove crackles. The end.)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [storytelling] FINAL TITLE CARD

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: An illustrated hand scatters the letters across the screen. They form the episode words: juice, salad, poppy, Mama, cat, wasp, metal container, kick scooter, and ball of thread.
